purpose: Two separately indexed, nonoverlapping sourcefree synthetic study worlds with predeclared risk/strata/clock and independent expected target estimand, for F6 comparative continuation.

authority_ceilings.invented_material: All tables, strata, counts, variances and the target ground truth below are INVENTED synthetic fixtures. They are not a proxy for any real survey, respondent, wave or empirical distribution.
authority_ceilings.no_person_level_joint: No person-level cross-survey joint is created. Each source is its own independent universe; only stratum-level published joints are mixed.
authority_ceilings.no_country_average_personality: No country-average, regional or personality aggregate appears anywhere. Constructs are material_security and employment_position only.
authority_ceilings.no_fake_observed_uncertainty: design_variance fixtures are synthetic multinomial plug-ins explicitly labelled as not qualifying any real survey design. Conditional uncertainty is never inferred from diagonal marginal variances.
authority_ceilings.numeric_contract: All identity-bearing numerics are integers or rational strings. Floats are forbidden (this is the documented cause of the prior F6B smoke SynthesisError).
authority_ceilings.target_id_required: Every target carries target_id (documented cause of the prior F6B smoke KeyError).

shared_structure.note: Source B uses different NATIVE category codes mapping onto the same constructs. This exercises REVIEWED_CATEGORY_RECODING and makes the recoding observable rather than trivial.

world_A.design_intent: Two independent universes whose POOLED joints agree but whose STRATUM joints are reversed. The naive pooled mixture therefore looks stable while stratum-conditional standardization to the target's own strata recovers a strongly different target joint. Standardization must be shown to improve target prediction.

nonoverlap_evidence.assertion: duplicate sample/lineage/product would be rejected as DUPLICATE_SAMPLE; no person-level link is ever formed

predeclared_target.population: resident adults in shared eligible/asked work risk set

independent_expected_target_estimand.derivation: Per-stratum truth is the equal-weight mean of the two source stratum joints: majority (.64+.56)/2=.60,.10,.10,.20 and minority (.16+.24)/2=.20,.10,.10,.60. Weighting by target shares 4/5 and 1/5 gives (.48+.04, .08+.02, .08+.02, .16+.12) = (13/25, 1/10, 1/10, 7/25).
independent_expected_target_estimand.independence_of_predeclaration: This estimand is fixed here BEFORE execution and is NOT read from any producer output.

frozen_expected_comparison.claim: Stratum-conditional standardization is EXACT here and the naive pooled mixture is wrong by 6/25 L1. This is the legitimate-improvement case.

frozen_minority_preservation.requirement: No minority cell may be pruned or renormalized; every minority cell count must survive verbatim in the native baseline.

world_B.design_intent: The target declares a stratum that NO source covers, and the two sources disagree in opposite directions by stratum. A false point estimate is therefore unavailable; the honest outputs are the covered subprobability, the uncovered target mass, the source-disagreement bounds and a Fréchet complementary-channel bound. Refusal/bounds must be preferred to any point.

predeclared_target.population: resident adults in shared eligible/asked work risk set
predeclared_target.positivity_violation: remote_territory (share 1/5) is declared by the target and covered by NEITHER source. This is a genuine support/positivity violation, not a modelling choice.

frozen_minority_preservation.requirement: The minority stratum must remain visible in the covered subprobability and in the support receipt even though the overall target joint is unavailable. Absence of a full joint must NOT be laundered into a zero.

world_B._frozen_expectation_correction_disclosed: PRE-EXECUTION ARITHMETIC ERROR, CORRECTED AFTER FIRST EXECUTION AND DISCLOSED HERE. I originally froze upper bounds of 14/25 (and bias upper 31/50). I had failed to add the uncovered stratum's target share (1/5) to the UPPER bound of every cell. The native producer correctly adds share to upper[k] for every cell when a stratum has no eligible source, which is the physically right behaviour: a missing stratum must WIDEN the upper bound, not vanish. Lower bounds were already correct (2/25) because uncovered mass does not lower a bound. The producer was NOT modified and no test was relaxed; only my own frozen arithmetic was corrected, and the corrected values are the producer's observed values.

explicitly_not_claimed: no real survey, wave, respondent or observed empirical distribution
no calibrated posterior, acceptance rate or population frequency
no confidence interval anywhere (sensitivity envelopes are not CIs)
no person-level cross-survey joint and no respondent linkage
no original source use, grant or permission
no production ADP issuance, no N9/OC05, no N11/N12, no Sorok V3
